1 3:21 What does the science agree on??That changing how you think about stress can change your body's response to stress.
2 3:32 What activity does she want the audience to take part in??She wants them to imagine they are participants in a study called the social stress test.
3 3:51 How is the test supposed to make you feel??It is supposed to make you feel stressed and under pressure — you have to give a five-minute impromptu speech on your personal weaknesses.
4 4:07 What were the evaluators trained to do??They were trained to give discouraging, non-verbal feedback to the participants.
5 4:19 What is unknown to the participants of the test??That the experimenter has been trained to harass them during the second part of the test — a math task.
6 4:39 What was the audience instructed to do??They were told to count backwards from 996 in increments of seven, out loud and as fast as possible.
7 4:54 How did she make them feel??A bit stressed out — the activity put them under pressure in a playful way.
